notes.title: Major Update and New Game Mode
notes.content:
The first major update to 1979 Invasion Earth is here. Here is a list of the major changes 

1 - Graphics have been changed throughout.
2 - Sleeker Controls
3 - Faster Bullets
4 - A Brand New Game Mode - A two player battle mode ( requires a keyboard and joypad )
5 - And loads of minor tweaks..
